title: Arrangement Deposit Calculation Memo, Insurance Coverage & Patient Responsibility
content:
**Credit office memo — arrangement deposit, Insurance Coverage & Patient Responsibility.**

**Clause.** The figured arrangement deposit is the deposit percentage of the account's patient balance at the time the deposit is figured, rounded to the cent half up, and the deposit the patient pays is that figured deposit. The deposit percentage is 10.

**Inputs.**

- *Patient balance*: the patient balance of the coverage account on which the arrangement is to be opened, as it stands at the moment the deposit is figured.
- *Deposit percentage*: 10 percent.

**Worked figure (hypothetical).** A coverage account whose patient balance stands at 742.55 when the deposit is figured:

| Line | Working | Amount |
|---|---|---|
| Patient balance | as it stands when figured | 742.55 |
| Deposit percentage | — | 10 percent |
| 10 percent of 742.55 | 74.255, rounded to the cent half up | 74.26 |
| Deposit the patient pays | the figured deposit | **74.26** |

**Rounding at the half cent (hypothetical).** A balance of 300.05 gives 30.005, which rounds half up to 30.01.
